About This Game

🎉 Major update: “Your Fiancée – AI Companion Expansion DLC” is now available for free!

《Your Fiancée》

Your personal desktop companion, by your side every day

She is more than ordinary software.

She is an elegant, mature companion who lives on your desktop—
there while you work, study, or unwind, and ready to help organize daily life.

Customize her appearance and outfits freely to make her a truly one-of-a-kind desktop companion.

From hardware monitoring, task planning, and money management to pet collecting, music, and desktop decoration...

She will become the most special presence on your PC.

✨ Create your own elegant companion

She has a distinctive charm that is elegant, mature, and alluring.

Customize her:

◆ Hair color
◆ Eye color
◆ Earrings
◆ Many other appearance details

A rich outfit system is included too:

👗 Mix and match a wide range of signature outfits

Try a different style every day and keep your desktop feeling fresh.

🖥️ Powerful hardware monitoring

She is not only good company; she is also your PC assistant.

Choose between two hardware-monitoring layouts:

Simple Mode

Ideal for everyday use:

  • CPU usage

  • GPU usage

  • Memory status

  • Temperature monitoring

  • Drive status

  • Network status

See how your PC is running at a glance.

Advanced Hardware Monitoring

Built for power users.

View more detailed data:

  • Detailed CPU information

  • Real-time GPU status

  • Video memory usage

  • Core clock speeds

  • Temperature graphs

  • Power consumption

  • System status analysis

Turn your desktop companion into a professional PC monitoring tool.

🌟 Steam Workshop — Expand Your Desktop World Without Limits

Your desktop companion can be so much more.

With Steam Workshop, explore a wealth of content created by players around the world:

🎀 A huge collection of anime-style characters
🎀 Personalized desktop-pet designs
🎀 Unique outfits and styles
🎀 Original player creations

Simply subscribe to add a favorite character to your desktop and keep your desktop world feeling alive and new.

✨ Subscribe to characters you love

In the Workshop, you can:

  • Browse character creations shared by other players

  • Subscribe to a favorite desktop pet with one click

  • Download and apply it to the game automatically

  • Switch your desktop companion whenever you like

A new character may be waiting every day.

Your desktop never has to look the same twice.

🎨 Create your own desktop companion

If inspiration strikes, you can become a creator too.

The game includes a convenient Steam Workshop upload tool:

Upload characters you have made and share them with players around the world.

Create:

  • Unique character designs

  • Personalized desktop pets

  • Original anime-style characters

  • A desktop companion of your own

Bring your creations to desktops around the world.

⏰ A little helper for better productivity

She helps you manage your time and get more out of every day.

🍅 Pomodoro Timer

Use the classic Pomodoro method:

Focus → Take a timed break → Stay at your best

Build a steadier rhythm for work and study.

🔔 Smart Reminders

Set reminders for anything you do not want to forget:

  • Work reminders

  • Study plans

  • Important dates

  • Everyday tasks

She will remind you when the time is right.

🖼️ Image Motion Workshop

Bring your pictures to life.

You can:

  • Import any image

  • Paint the areas you want to move

  • Adjust motion settings

Easily create:

✨ Animated wallpaper effects
✨ Live2D-style image effects
✨ Fun desktop decorations

✅ To-Do List

A complete task-management system:

  • Create tasks

  • Organize by category

  • Plan your tasks

  • Track completed tasks

Keep each day's goals organized.

💰 Easy Expense Tracker

Manage your everyday finances.

Record:

  • Daily spending

  • Income and expenses

  • Spending categories

  • Financial planning

See clearly where every bit of your money goes.

🌱 Endless Planter — every growth cycle is a surprise

A tiny world that never repeats itself.

With every plant growth cycle:

🌱 Random plant shapes
🌱 Different growth paths
🌱 Endless fruit to collect

You never know what you will grow next.

Place a little life on your desktop and watch it slowly grow.

🎁 Gacha Machine × Pet-Girl Collection

Collect new desktop friends!

The gacha machine can give you:

💕 Adorable pet girls
👾 Curious little monsters

These little friends live near the Windows taskbar:

  • Roam freely

  • Run around

  • Keep you company while you use your PC

A colorful cast is waiting to be collected.

Build your own little desktop ecosystem.

🎵 A more soothing desktop atmosphere

Ambient Sound Player

Choose from immersive soundscapes such as:

  • Rain

  • Forest

  • Cafe

  • Nature sounds and more

Turn your desktop into a small space to unwind.

Lofi Music Player

Includes:

🎧 80 handpicked Lofi tracks

Perfect for:

  • Work

  • Study

  • Reading

  • Relaxing

Give your PC an atmosphere of its own.

🎮 Free Game Alerts

Keep up with free games on Steam and Epic every day.

Automatically collects:

  • Limited-time free game details

  • Game overviews

  • Store links

Discover free games without missing your chance to claim them.

🖱️ Custom Mouse Trails

20 distinctive mouse effects:

  • Magic particles

  • Starlight

  • Futuristic effects

  • Cute styles

Give every mouse movement a little personality.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

The game's core content was created through extensive manual development. The main character, outfits, and all Live2D models are entirely hand-drawn, manually rigged, animated, and polished by the developer.

AI was used only as a limited production aid for a small number of UI illustrations, some optional Gacha characters (which were extensively edited, layered, animated, and refined by hand), store images,and the soundtrack.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This game may contains general sexual maturity content and may not be suitable for access in all situations, such as study and workplaces, please note!
